scope: Current-source context for the owner's reported concurrent 25-job portfolio planning. No 25-job execution, buyer demand, revenue, market share or billion-dollar outcome is established by this research. The present bounded experiment continues unchanged.
permission_boundary: Read-only public research; no outreach, subscription, spending, account action or additional service production.

primary_sources.evidence_type: Vendor-published summary of its response-management survey

facts.population: Response teams represented in Loopio's 2026 report
facts.qualifier: The public summary does not establish whether this is aggregate person-hours or elapsed working duration; do not multiply it by contributor count or treat it as a verified complete-cost invoice.

facts.unit: percent of represented response teams that have used generative AI in the RFP process
facts.qualifier: Not 79% of all workers, all companies, or fully autonomous enterprises. Adoption is not proof of autonomous accepted delivery.

primary_sources.applicability: A category-level workload/adoption lead for enterprise proposals. It does not price a matched managed service or calibrate unrelated software, analysis, document or customer-operations jobs.
primary_sources.limitations: Vendor survey summary; sampling frame, weighting and detailed time definition were not independently verified. Some unrelated headings retain inconsistent year/value wording; no additional numerical claims are imported.

facts.sample_description: More than 1,500 global participants/companies; developed with APMP

primary_sources.limitations: Public landing-page descriptions vary between participants and companies. Full report and underlying response-level data were not obtained; no form or contact information was submitted.

primary_sources.project_unit: An RFP, DDQ, tender or security questionnaire; generally one CRM opportunity, regardless of requirement count or accompanying documents.
primary_sources.other_terms: Unlimited users and features; implementation/support included. Page states a minimum 12-month term after the initial 30-day period.
primary_sources.applicability: Credible customer software outside option. Subscription access is not a matched autonomous managed-service price, acceptance guarantee or measured customer acquisition result.
primary_sources.currency_caution: Fetched official pricing text does not explicitly identify USD. Keep amounts in displayed dollars until currency is verified; no implicit conversion.

primary_sources.billing_caution: Page exposes monthly and annual billing options with a 15% annual saving; amounts recorded here are the displayed monthly prices, not an independently executed checkout.
primary_sources.applicability: Questionnaire automation with approved company sources is an existing competitive alternative. Software access, answer generation and a complete accepted managed delivery have different obligations.
primary_sources.currency_caution: Fetched official pricing text does not explicitly identify USD. No paid checkout or account creation was performed.

arithmetic_only.unit: displayed dollars of annual subscription allocation per included project at full utilization
displayed dollars of annual subscription allocation per included project at full utilization

arithmetic_limits: These divisions are software-budget allocations, not per-job managed-service prices, full customer cost, observed usage, realized savings or demand forecasts. They exclude customer production/review obligations and assume every included project is used.
execution_implications: Preserve premium initial offers near a matched complete human-service cost with an explicit small discount; AI cost savings remain available margin.

Include software-assisted self-service and managed competitors in buyer outside options; customer setup, knowledge access, review, switching costs and confidential-data obligations must remain explicit.

Before extending into proposals, freeze a factual source/answer matrix, unsupported-claim rejection, compliance requirements, acceptance and revision obligations. Do not equate a sourced draft with an accepted bid or winning a contract.
Retain priority categories as hypotheses for a separate authorized portfolio; one qualified service does not validate all five categories.

Treat US$1 billion as an owner ambition requiring separately declared horizon, price, customer count, capacity, collection, complete costs and cash timing. No market-share or sales assumption is established here.
